title: Work for constructing Vandermonde power rows
statement: For each natural number $\ell$, define the work for constructing $p$ Vandermonde power rows recursively by $W(0)=0$ and, for $p\ge 0$, $W(p+1)=W(p)+B(\ell,p+1)+\ell+1$, where $B(\ell,e)$ is the work for constructing a small-bias power with parameters $\ell,e$.
